title: Decision in the case of Emre Akbulut
paragraphs: The verdict has been announced in the trial of Anadolu Line correspondent Emre Akbulut on charges of defamation. The result is: acquittal.

According to the indictment, Emre Akbulut insulted a public official with the news of the relief distribution of earthquake container cities published on 21 October 2025. The sentence was carried out by the Turkish Penal Code 125 (designation).
The verdict was issued by Hatay 2nd Prime Criminal Court on March 19, 2026, which has not yet been issued.
In the case of Emre Akbulut, Attorney Murat Aksoy said the report was considered a crime without an expert examination.
Emre Akbulut works as Hatay correspondent at the Anadolu Line. Press occupational organisations have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
There will be an appeal against the decision.
